## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      14 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 29, 2026 - Jul 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _OneSs_, Jul 16, 2026, 1/5: "Buggy app changes extra!!"
            2. _Pt18495_, Jul 16, 2026, 1/5: "This app has stolen £21 off me thanks to their service not working. I use this awful app everyday because it’s cheap and if it works it can be good. However. Yesterday I started my ride, Forest servers went down and their service was impacted. They even put a notice on the app about it, this “impact to service” prevented me from ending my ride. I got charged an additional £21 because I did not have the ability to end the ride. My money was literally stolen by this apps horrendous software. I have screenshots of me trying to close the app, of the service impact notice, I reported it as a bug straight away, I tried getting help from live chat but Forest has disabled it and this morning it is still disabled. I have had my money stolen and can’t even make a claim, having all the evidence of their fault. Stay away from this thinly veiled scam. I will be using like bikes from now on, their competitor is much more robust and better. I’ve sent this review in the hope to save others from being stolen against."
            3. _It’s_Georgie_, Jul 16, 2026, 2/5: "The 10 free minutes is a lie, the app is slow, and if you try to contact their support team, the lines are always busy. No calls, no live chat, nothing. Good luck. Good to use when there are no lime bikes around."
